what: CRC-SLICE (2026-10-25): zlib's CRC-32 eight bytes a step (slicing-by-8, runtime/c/bcir_crc32.h) for every C unit that checks one -- bcir_runtime.c's bcir_crc32 (every StreamPack, plan, record, bundle and frame digest) and the BCIRQ8 loader, whose bitwise loop it retires -- the same CRC by definition; measured on the committed tree against the tree before, with NEXT-6 (the survey that placed it) on the tree before
host: Intel(R) Xeon(R) Processor @ 2.30GHz, 4 vCPU (4 cores, one thread each; AVX-512F, AMX), 2 MiB of L2 a core, 260 MiB of L3; Linux 6.18; clang 18.1.3 and GCC 13.3 (-std=c11 -O2 -ffp-contract=off, the qualification's flags); the system's zlib 1.3 (crc_ab.c's third arm, Python's zlib in the 2026-10-10 note's stage); Python 3.11.15; valgrind's callgrind for the simulated rows

records.crc.json: crc_ab.c, one process: the tree before's bcir_crc32 and BCIRQ8 loader (their objects' globals renamed before_*) against the tree after's, zlib's crc32 beside them, an A/A control; the 2026-10-10 note's sizes, the qualification's pack (609,997 octets) and the lab model's file (912,840), and both lab models' loads; every CRC zlib's
records.trust.json: trust_parts.c built against each tree, the two in alternation five times: a CRC pass over the qualification's pack, bcir_sp_validate, bcir_sp_verify_semantic, the segment and block walks, the four as GEM's load calls them, and bcir_sp_execute with a callback that does nothing (what a GEM run pays before its kernels)
records.requests.json: request_ab.py: the standalone C decoder from each tree, a whole request timed (the model's load, a 5-token prompt, 1, 8 and 64 new tokens), 24 rounds, clang and gcc, both lab models; every run's tokens and final logits the tree before's bytes
records.qualification.json: qual_crc.py over run_qualification.py --require-callgrind from each tree
records.qualification-repeats.json: qual_repeat.sh: run_qualification.py from each tree three times in alternation without callgrind, each run's C latency rows
records.note-crc.json: the 2026-10-10 performance note's own CRC stage (../../2026-10-10/run_performance_tests.py --stage crc) on each tree
records.faults.json: red_sweep.py: crc-slice.json on the committed tree's content
records.explore.json: NEXT-6 on the tree before, with the commands that ran (explore_trust_parts.c and dump_pack.py the instruments written apart)
records.hashes.json: the committed tools' sha256, the measured sources' and the pack's
records.the tools: measure_crc.sh and qual_repeat.sh (the records' runs, the second after the first) and the instruments they ran -- crc_ab.c, trust_parts.c, request_ab.py, qual_crc.py, dump_pack.py -- the bytes that ran; the scripts' host paths as placeholders (<REPO>, <SCRATCH>, <LAB>, <LAB2>), which filled in are the run copies byte for byte
